user.title: Set up Bambu Live Activity
user.description: Choose a printer provided by the Bambu Lab custom integration and the Home Assistant Companion App notification action for your iPhone.

data_description.printer_device: The printer whose print progress should appear as a Live Activity.
data_description.notify_service: Use notify.mobile_app_<device>. Live Activities require the Home Assistant iOS Companion App.

error.not_bambu_device: The selected device does not have a Bambu Lab printer identifier.
error.missing_bambu_entities: Required Bambu Lab print sensors are missing. Make sure ha-bambulab is fully loaded and the printer exposes print status, progress, remaining time, end time, and subtask name.
error.notify_action_unavailable: That notify action is not currently available.

abort.already_configured: This Bambu printer is already configured.

init.title: Live Activity behaviour
init.description: Tune how often the activity is refreshed. Lower thresholds feel more live but can be throttled by iOS when updates are not delivered through Local Push.

data.notify_finished: Send a normal notification when finished
data.notify_failed: Send a normal notification when a print fails

data_description.progress_step: Send an update after progress changes by at least this many percentage points.
data_description.eta_threshold_minutes: Send an update when remaining time or finish time changes by at least this many minutes.
data_description.debounce_seconds: Combine Bambu MQTT updates arriving close together into one Live Activity update.
